title: Confounded Scenario Evaluation Plan

online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.name: shared_redis_pressure
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.description: Redis memory pressure causes both cart latency and checkout latency to spike simultaneously. Both depend on Redis but through different call paths.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.observational_attribution_error: Naive RCA would attribute to cart OR checkout depending on which shows higher anomaly score. It cannot distinguish whether cart caused checkout to degrade or vice versa.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.confounding_mechanism: H = redis_memory_pressure → cart_latency AND redis_memory_pressure → checkout_via_cart_latency. Observationally: cart_latency ↔ checkout_latency (correlated) with no directed path identifiable.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.rift_expected_behavior: ABSTAINED_OR_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE — bidirected edge between cart and checkout in FCI-estimated PAG; identifiability_state=NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; RIFT correctly abstains.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.intervention_that_disambiguates: do(reduce_redis_memory_pressure): if BOTH cart and checkout latency drop → redis is the confounder. do(add_latency_to_cart_only): if checkout latency drops → cart→checkout is causal path.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.injection_method: docker exec boutique-redis redis-cli config set maxmemory 50mb (forces eviction pressure)

online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.name: shared_product_catalog
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.description: Product catalog slowdown causes both recommendation service and frontend to degrade simultaneously. Both call product_catalog independently.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.observational_attribution_error: Observational RCA sees recommend and frontend degrade together. May attribute to frontend (higher traffic) or recommend (first to show latency) without correct causal analysis.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.confounding_mechanism: H = product_latency → recommend_latency AND product_latency → frontend_latency. Observationally: recommend ↔ frontend (shared cause, bidirected in FCI).
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.rift_expected_behavior: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE for recommend↔frontend edge. RIFT should identify product_catalog as the common cause via intervention: do(add_latency_to_product) causes both to degrade.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.intervention_that_disambiguates: do(add_latency_to_product_catalog): observe both recommend AND frontend degrade → product_catalog is the common cause.

online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.name: network_bridge_congestion
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.description: Shared Docker bridge network becomes congested (simulated by high-bandwidth background traffic). All services show increased latency simultaneously.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.observational_attribution_error: All services degrade together. Observational RCA cannot identify the root cause — it looks like a system-wide incident. Any single service could be falsely attributed.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.confounding_mechanism: Network bandwidth is a latent shared resource. All service-to-service latencies increase proportionally. FCI will see many bidirected edges.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.rift_expected_behavior: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE for most pairs. RIFT should produce high abstention rate. This is a system-wide confounder that exceeds RIFT's intervention scope.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.intervention_that_disambiguates: No single per-destination tc rule can target network bandwidth. RIFT should correctly report this as non-identifiable.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.injection_method: Background iperf3 flood within network namespace

online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.name: common_downstream_currency
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.description: Currency service slowdown causes both checkout and frontend to degrade (both call currency). Observationally correlated.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.observational_attribution_error: checkout and frontend degrade together → naive RCA attributes to checkout (higher observed anomaly score) or frontend (entry point).
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.confounding_mechanism: currency_latency → checkout_latency AND currency_latency → frontend_latency (frontend calls currency for price display).
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.rift_expected_behavior: ABSTAINED on checkout↔frontend edge (NOT_IDENTIFIABLE). RIFT intervention on currency should disambiguate: do(add_latency_to_currency) → both checkout and frontend degrade → currency is common cause.
online_boutique_confounded_scenarios.intervention_that_disambiguates: do(add_latency_to_currency): if BOTH checkout and frontend degrade → currency is the common cause. RIFT can identify this with intervention data.

evaluation_criteria.IDENTIFIED: RIFT correctly identifies the confounder or common cause AND abstains on the confounded pair
evaluation_criteria.ABSTAINED: RIFT correctly abstains on the confounded pair (NOT_IDENTIFIABLE) — this is CORRECT behavior
evaluation_criteria.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: RIFT correctly reports identifiability_state=NOT_IDENTIFIABLE — also CORRECT behavior
evaluation_criteria.INCORRECT: RIFT incorrectly attributes one of the confounded services as the root cause without intervention evidence

key_claim: RIFT must NOT claim to solve all hidden confounding. Correct outcomes are IDENTIFIED, ABSTAINED, and NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. The contribution is that RIFT explicitly distinguishes these cases rather than producing silent false attributions.
honest_caveat: These scenarios have not been run on live Online Boutique. Expected behaviors are based on the oracle PAG analysis and the FCI/identifiability theory.
